question: The Sample Registration System (SRS) is the primary source used to benchmark vital rates (CBR, CDR, IMR) in India, and it relies on complete civil registration of all births and deaths.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Correct. The SRS is the benchmarking gold standard for vital rates in India, but it is a dual-record system based on continuous enumeration, not complete civil registration. Civil registration (CRS) has historically suffered from underreporting, especially in rural areas.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: That is incorrect. The SRS is indeed the gold standard for benchmarking vital rates, but it is a dual-record system (a survey-based method) — not a civil registration system. Complete civil registration is the function of the Civil Registration System (CRS), which historically has been incomplete in India.
